svg.title: attention shapes
svg.text: 1.8 Attention for one head: q kᵀ → mask → softmax → @ v
prefill of N tokens (T = N keys); all 32 heads do this at the same time on their own slabs
each row: weights ≥ 0 that sum to 1

g.text: each row: weights ≥ 0 that sum to 1

svg.text: Decode: N = 1 (one row), T = whole context;
no mask needed (the one query is the newest).
animated: k turns into kᵀ; row × column fill the score table; the mask greys the upper triangle; rows are softmaxed; rows of P mix the rows of v
